verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents that each CKS cluster runs in its own private VPC, with InfiniBand networking and Terraform-managed VPC networking, which covers connecting nodes over private networking. Nothing in the pack shows how to expose ports or serve applications publicly from an instance, such as load balancers, ingress or public IPs. missing for 10: documentation of port exposure/public ingress for serving applications, detail on how instances connect privately (subnets, peering, cross-cluster connectivity), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking
